name: slurm
description: Slurm cluster status: nodes, queue, jobs, accounting (read-only)

down_nodes.describe: nodes that are down, drained or failing, with reasons (node|state|reason|user|time)

partitions.describe: partition summary: partition|availability|time limit|nodes total|nodes allocated/idle/other/total|cpus allocated/idle/other/total

queue.describe: all jobs in the queue: job|partition|name|user|state|time|nodes|reason or nodes

queue_user.describe: jobs of one user: job|partition|name|state|time|nodes|reason or nodes

queue_partition.describe: jobs in one partition: job|name|user|state|time|nodes|reason or nodes

job.describe: details of one job (scontrol show job)
usage: Only for jobs still known to the controller (pending, running, or ended in the last few minutes); for older ones, use jobs_history_user.
Read JobState and Reason first; for a pending job, Reason says why it waits (Priority and Resources: wait; a *Limit reason: waiting won't help).
TimeLimit, NumCPUs, MinMemoryNode or MinMemoryCPU, and StdOut give what was asked for and where its log is.

node.describe: details of one node (scontrol show node)

jobs_history_user.describe: jobs of one user in the last day, from accounting: job|name|partition|state|exit code|elapsed|start|end|nodes
usage: One line per job (-X: the job, not its steps), fields separated by |.
ExitCode is code:signal; 0:0 is success. State OUT_OF_MEMORY, TIMEOUT and NODE_FAIL each need a different fix (more memory, more time, a resubmit).
An empty answer means no jobs in the last day, or an unknown user: it is not an error.
